Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim for {CLAIM_NUMBER} has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. Specifically, your policy includes the following provision: "[COLL-1] We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

As a result of this approval, the payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued, with a {DEDUCTIBLE} applied.

Regarding the next steps, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us using the information provided in your claim file.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
